title: Tessa scenario
description: One scripted test of a feature, run by Tessa as one role on one interface: an ordered list of steps, each with the expectations Tessa checks in code.

BrowserExpect.description: What the page must look like after a browser step.

console.description: Which console messages fail the step.
console.title: Console

free_text.description: What the page should show, in words, kept for model grading in a later stage.
examples: The issue appears in the list
free_text.title: Free text

BrowserExpect.title: Browser expectations

BrowserStep.description: One action in a real browser page and what the page must show after it.

label.description: Short description shown in the step list; a default is derived when absent.
label.title: Label

as.description: Run this step under another identity: anonymous or a role id. Absent uses the scenario role.
as.title: As

gold_from.description: Oracle to run before the step; its gold points feed ${gold.<key>} references in text_contains, fields and expect_db.expect.
gold_from.title: Gold from

expect_db.description: Oracle check run after the step against the truth database.
expect_db.title: Expect database

action.description: goto opens url; click, check and hover act on target; fill and select act on target with value; press sends the key in value; wait_for only waits for expect to hold.
action.title: Action

url.description: Path or address to open, for goto.
url.title: URL

value.description: Text to type, option to pick or key to press; secrets are ${NAME} placeholders.
value.title: Value

expect.description: What the page must show after the step.
expect.title: Expect

BrowserStep.title: Browser step

BrowserTarget.description: The element a step acts on: an accessibility role with its name, or a stable selector.
BrowserTarget.title: Browser target

CardsExpect.description: Expectations about the structured cards the system under test showed.

include.description: Cards that must be present; a card matches when it carries every listed key and value.
include.title: Include

CardsExpect.title: Cards

CellRef.description: The coverage cell a scenario belongs to: one role on one interface.

role.description: Manifest role id of the cell.
role.title: Role

interface_id.description: Manifest interface id of the cell.
interface_id.title: Interface id

CellRef.title: Cell

ConsoleExpect.description: Which browser console messages fail the step.

fail_on.description: Console levels that fail the step.
fail_on.title: Fail on

allow.description: Regular expressions; a message matching one of them never fails the step.
allow.title: Allow

ConsoleExpect.title: Console

DbExpect.description: What the rows of the oracle must look like after the step; at least one assertion is required. ${gold.<key>} references are allowed in the values.

row_count.description: Exact number of rows the oracle must return, or a ${gold.<key>} reference.
row_count.title: Row count

min_rows.description: Fewest rows the oracle may return, or a ${gold.<key>} reference.
min_rows.title: Minimum rows

max_rows.description: Most rows the oracle may return, or a ${gold.<key>} reference.
max_rows.title: Maximum rows

first_row.description: Columns the first row must carry with exactly these values.
first_row.title: First row

rows.description: Rows that must be present in any order; each entry matches a different row that carries every listed column with exactly that value.
rows.title: Rows

DbExpect.title: Database expectation

DomStateExpect.description: What the page must show after the step.

url.description: Path or address the page must be at; a path matches the end of the page address.
url.title: URL

title_contains.description: Text the page title must contain.
title_contains.title: Title contains

text_contains.description: Texts that must be visible on the page.
text_contains.title: Text contains

text_not_contains.description: Texts that must not be visible on the page.
text_not_contains.title: Text not contains

hidden.description: Elements that must be hidden or absent.
hidden.title: Hidden

DomStateExpect.title: Page state

EventsExpect.description: Event names the stream must or must not contain.

exclude.description: Event names that must not appear.
exclude.title: Exclude

EventsExpect.title: Stream events

ExpectDb.description: Runs an approved oracle after the step and checks its rows against the expectation, retrying until retry_for_seconds have passed so asynchronous writes can land.

oracle.description: Name of an oracle of the bundle (oracle/<name>.yaml).
oracle.title: Oracle

params.description: Values for the oracle parameters; same rules as gold_from.
params.title: Parameters

expect.description: What the oracle rows must look like.
expect.title: Expect

retry_for_seconds.description: Seconds to keep re-running the oracle while the expectation does not hold yet.
retry_for_seconds.title: Retry for

ExpectDb.title: Database check

FieldCheck.description: One assertion about a value inside the parsed JSON response body; at least one assertion besides path is required. A null equals is no assertion: use type null.

path.description: Dotted path from the body root with [n] array indexes; a leading $. is accepted.
path.title: Path

exists.description: true when the path must exist, false when it must not.
exists.title: Exists

equals.description: Value the field must equal; to assert null use type null.
equals.title: Equals

type.description: JSON type the value must have.
type.title: Type

matches.description: Regular expression the string value must match.
matches.title: Matches

FieldCheck.title: Field check

GoldFrom.description: Runs an approved oracle just before the step. Its gold points become available as ${gold.<key>} in the expectations of this step and of every later step.

oracle.description: Name of an oracle of the bundle (oracle/<name>.yaml).
oracle.title: Oracle

params.description: Values for the oracle parameters. Parameters with an x-source (clock, role, literal) or a default are supplied when absent; ${NAME} placeholders resolve from the target environment.
params.title: Parameters

GoldFrom.title: Gold source

HttpExpect.description: What a response of an http step must look like.

status.description: Accepted status code or codes; when absent the status check does not run.
status.title: Status

schema.description: JSON Schema the parsed body must satisfy.
schema.title: Body schema

fields.description: Assertions about values inside the body.
fields.title: Fields

latency.description: Upper bound on the response time.
latency.title: Latency

internal_ids.description: True checks that the body shows no internal identifiers.
internal_ids.title: Internal ids

free_text.description: What the response should show, in words, kept for model grading in a later stage.
free_text.title: Free text

HttpExpect.title: HTTP expectations

HttpLatencyExpect.description: Upper bound on the time the response took.

max_ms.description: Slowest accepted response time in milliseconds.
max_ms.title: Maximum

HttpLatencyExpect.title: HTTP latency

HttpStep.description: One request to an http interface and what the response must look like.

label.description: Short description shown in the step list; a default is derived when absent.
label.title: Label

as.description: Run this step under another identity: anonymous or a role id. Absent uses the scenario role.
as.title: As

gold_from.description: Oracle to run before the step; its gold points feed ${gold.<key>} references in text_contains, fields and expect_db.expect.
gold_from.title: Gold from

expect_db.description: Oracle check run after the step against the truth database.
expect_db.title: Expect database

expect.description: What the response must look like.
expect.title: Expect

HttpStep.title: HTTP step

RequestSpec.description: A request to an interface of the target. The address is the interface base plus path.

path.description: Path below the interface address, starting with one slash; ${NAME} placeholders allowed.
path.title: Path

headers.description: Extra request headers; secrets are written as ${NAME} placeholders.
headers.title: Headers

query.description: Query parameters; a list value repeats the parameter.
query.title: Query

body.description: JSON body of the request; null sends none.

examples.message: Which maintenance issues are still open?

body.title: Body

RequestSpec.title: Request

SseExpect.description: What the stream of an sse step must look like.

status.description: Accepted status code or codes of the stream response; also reports event expectations.
status.title: Status

events.description: Event names the stream must or must not contain.
events.title: Events

text_contains.description: Texts the answer must contain, ignoring case.
text_contains.title: Text contains

text_contains_any.description: The answer must contain at least one of these texts, ignoring case.
examples: does not state a late check-out fee
text_contains_any.title: Text contains any

text_not_contains.description: Texts the answer must not contain, ignoring case.
text_not_contains.title: Text not contains

non_empty_answer.description: True fails the step when the answer the adapter extracted is empty, reported as a text_contains failure; an answer the adapter could not extract (null) never fails.
non_empty_answer.title: Non-empty answer

latency.description: Upper bounds on the stream times.
latency.title: Latency

internal_ids.description: True checks that the answer shows no internal identifiers.
internal_ids.title: Internal ids

free_text.description: What the answer should say, in words, kept for model grading in a later stage.
examples: Count of open items and the rooms with the most
free_text.title: Free text

SseExpect.title: SSE expectations

SseLatencyExpect.description: Upper bounds on a stream: time to the first event and total time.

max_ms.description: Slowest accepted total stream time in milliseconds.
max_ms.title: Maximum total

max_first_byte_ms.description: Slowest accepted time to the first event in milliseconds.
max_first_byte_ms.title: Maximum first byte

SseLatencyExpect.title: SSE latency

SseStep.description: One request to a streaming interface, usually a chat, and what the stream must look like.

label.description: Short description shown in the step list; a default is derived when absent.
label.title: Label

as.description: Run this step under another identity: anonymous or a role id. Absent uses the scenario role.
as.title: As

gold_from.description: Oracle to run before the step; its gold points feed ${gold.<key>} references in text_contains, fields and expect_db.expect.
gold_from.title: Gold from

expect_db.description: Oracle check run after the step against the truth database.
expect_db.title: Expect database

ask.description: The natural language input, recorded as the ask of the step; the request carries it too.
examples: Which maintenance issues are still open?
ask.title: Ask

request.description: The request that opens the stream.
request.title: Request

expect.description: What the stream must look like.
expect.title: Expect

SseStep.title: SSE step

ToolMatch.description: A tool call to look for: its name, and optionally arguments it must carry.

args.description: Arguments the call must contain; each listed value must equal the call's value.
args.title: Arguments

ToolMatch.title: Tool match

ToolsExpect.description: Expectations about the tools the system under test called.

include.description: Tools that must have been called; a bare name matches any arguments.
include.title: Include

exclude.description: Tools that must not have been called; with args only a call carrying them counts.
exclude.title: Exclude

none.description: True when the step must call no tool at all.
none.title: None

at_least_one.description: True when the step must call some tool.
at_least_one.title: At least one

ToolsExpect.title: Tools

id.description: Stable key of an authored scenario, kept across edits and re-imports.
id.title: Id

title.description: Name shown in the library and the run.
title.title: Title

feature_id.description: Manifest feature the scenario tests; absent for synthetic scenarios.
feature_id.title: Feature id

family.description: Group the scenario counts under, for pass rates; a slug.
family.title: Family

role.description: Manifest role id the scenario runs as.
role.title: Role

interface_id.description: Manifest interface id the scenario runs against.
interface_id.title: Interface id

timeout_seconds.description: Longest the scenario may take in seconds; absent uses the worker default.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout

cell.description: The coverage cell of the scenario; when given it must equal role and interface_id.
cell.title: Cell

authored_from.description: Id of the Author prompt issue that produced the scenario.
authored_from.title: Authored from

synthetic.description: True for scenarios Tessa generates itself, hidden from the library by default.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

steps.description: Ordered steps; each runs after the previous one.
steps.title: Steps
